events.summary: Fuel supply shortfall: on 22 January 2022 the Ministry of Electricity attributed a sharp fall in electricity supply to reduced domestic gas output (which it linked to bad weather), a cut in imported gas and the loss of imported electricity. Its spokesman named Baghdad, Diyala, Kirkuk and the middle-Euphrates governorates as most affected.
events.effect: Ministry of Electricity, as carried by Shafaq News on 22 January 2022: 6,500 MW lost through gas shortage and 1,100 MW through the loss of imported electricity, which together 'drastically reduced' power supply hours; Shafaq gives the national loss as 7,500 MW. Al Jazeera (23 January 2022) reported a near-total outage of grid power in Iraqi governorates, the capital Baghdad above all, after the loss of 7,600 MW, and quoted the ministry spokesman that the gas cuts led to load limiting and the stoppage of many generating units.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 4, second limb: a generation shortfall that forced rotating outages. Shafaq reports the ministry's gas and imported-power losses 'drastically reduced' supply hours; Al Jazeera quotes the ministry spokesman that the gas cuts led to load limiting and the stoppage of many generating units. The date is the statement date; the onset is not stated.

capacity_affected.source_says: lost 7,500 Megawatts (Shafaq, ministry statement); lost capacity due to gas shortage 6,500 MW plus 1,100 MW of imports (Shafaq); 7,600 MW lost (Al Jazeera, own narration)

review.process: Found by a research lane; then reviewed blind by three independent reviewers, none of whom saw the researcher's rationale or each other: one opened the sources and checked identity, date, region, threshold and every figure; one checked the text for placement finer than first-level region, inventories, dependency and status wording; one checked class, cause, hazard name, episode and duplicates. Published only because all three accepted it; their corrections were reconciled into this text.

events.summary: Fuel supply shortfall: on 23 December 2025 the Ministry of Electricity announced that imported gas had stopped completely, the supplier having cited emergency conditions, and that the system had lost between 4,000 and 4,500 MW of generation.
events.effect: Ministry of Electricity, as carried by Attaqa: between 4,000 and 4,500 MW of generation lost; some units stopped and others load-limited; reduced supply hours in a number of governorates (not named). The ministry said it was running affected stations on domestic fuel.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 4 (generation shortfall): dated ministry statement (23 December 2025), stated cause (complete halt of imported gas) and stated size, "ما بين 4 آلاف و4500 ميغاواط من الكهرباء المنتجة".
